courses.name: The Bible, read as history and literature
courses.why: Whether or not you believe it, the Bible shapes laws, holidays and the people you meet.
units: Creation and flood stories in their world
Law and what it was for
How the New Testament was written
Reading carefully with no side taken

courses.name: Facing death and loss
courses.why: Everyone will face it; thinking clearly helps you live and grieve better.
units: Is death bad for the one who dies
How to face what you cannot change
Living with the time we have

courses.name: Ancient advice for a calm life
courses.why: Roman and Greek teachers still give short, free advice on temper, worry and duty.
units: What you control and what you do not
Respect and family in the Analects
Does believing it make a difference
A short plan for a hard week
